decisions.evidence: Putting all six neighbors together, the positive neighbors consistently reward the query for the oxadiazole motif, higher QED, and in several cases a favorable neutral fraction or more moderate logD. The negative neighbors mainly highlight tradeoffs involving sp3 fraction, ionizable/basic-acidic features, and polarity, but those do not dominate the overall pattern. Across the full set, the repeated advantages for the query on QED and the recurring oxadiazole gain, along with the more favorable neutral fraction and logD in key comparisons, make option (B), oral bioavailability ≥ 20%, the better final prediction.
